runtimeContext.percentBasis: Per-sample read fraction for known and candidate rows alike. viewedLocus is per source locus: Unique retained reads of the same sample at the same source locus (known alleles plus candidate clusters at that locus). sampleRetained: unique retained reads of the whole sample.
runtimeContext.prevalenceBasis: Samples where the row is visible with positive reads / full logical sample roster; 0 is off
